### 12. Contract

Operation ownership (GAP-0670, GAP-0671): rwb-integration owns POST /api/recovery/integration/v1/queues/{queueId}/placements on the integration base, takes the four body fields caseId, reason, modelOrAgent and version with a required Idempotency-Key, and answers 201 with the placement result or returns the rwb-case status and body unchanged. The case-base operation POST /api/recovery/case/v1/queues/{queueId}/placements is owned by P3 rwb-case and is consumed here. The JSON element names of the consumed contracts (the rwb-case placement, the rwb-case reference-data contract for rwb.casewf.placement.approved-callers and the rwb-access authorise contract) are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0671) until their owners publish them. The idempotency_key columns follow TSD P2 v3 T3.1; the decision_record columns are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0671). The replay window is 24 hours, the platform rule. The authorise call carries the request elements caller code, caller type, service identity, target queue, queue team code, case, product group, reason, model or agent version and field IDs (GAP-0957); the caller type is a carried value of the approved callers list and rwb_access holds no list of caller types. Refusal codes RIGHT_NOT_HELD, CALLER_KIND and SCOPE_NOT_ALL answer 403 with MSG-P4-002 as the message of every 403; the 422 and 503 codes are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0958) and keep MSG-GEN-001, MSG-GEN-002 and MSG-P7-003 as their messages; the adapter maps the code to its own refusal without restating the text.
